evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: The model pairs a Whisper encoder with task-specific classification heads.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: On a class-balanced test set drawn from a held-out podcast, it reaches 84.33% accuracy (95% CI 80.3 to 88.1) against 69.28% for the Smart-Turn v3 baseline, and lowers the false negative rate from 51.57% to 7.55% at the cost of a higher false positive rate.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On a class-balanced test set drawn from a held-out podcast, it reaches 84.33% accuracy (95% CI 80.3 to 88.1) against 69.28% for the Smart-Turn v3 baseline, and lowers the false negative rate from 51.57% to 7.55% at the cost of a higher false positive rate.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: The corpus holds 35,374 samples of 3 to 15 s of podcast speech, labelled for turn state by combining speaker diarization with an LLM pass, with every label then checked by a human annotator.
